items.claim: Judice outstruck both of her opponents in her two career losses.
items.quote: The two decisions that she lost, I mean, she out struck both of her opponents there.

items.claim: Chavez has nothing off her back on the mat.
items.quote: off her back, she's got nothing. Just nothing at all.

items.claim: GDS has good cardio and can keep the fight on the feet.
items.quote: she's got good cardio. She can keep the fight on the feet

items.claim: Wes Schultz lacks power in his strikes.
items.quote: He didn't have anything in the way of power

items.claim: Wes Schultz can mat return opponents effectively if they try to get up.
items.quote: he can mat return the heck out of you if you do start getting up and he's got a hold of you.

items.claim: Jackson McVey does not defend takedowns well at all.
items.quote: He doesn't defend takedowns well at all.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is moving up from light heavyweight to heavyweight.
items.quote: former light heavyweight moves up to heavyweight.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino's striking defense is not great and his hands are generally pretty low.
items.quote: his striking defense isn't great, and his hands are generally pretty low
